title: Expanded YouTube sponsored-placement cleanup
message: Adds broader cosmetic cleanup for YouTube promoted modules, sponsored search placements, merch shelves, Shorts panels and visible ad badges.
features: Additional YouTube ad-slot and sponsored-placement selectors
Promoted search, masthead and merch shelf cleanup
Shorts suggested-action and visible ad-badge cleanup
Newly hidden placements counted in local page-ad statistics
Existing allowlists, Shorts controls and ad-leak notices preserved
Cosmetic best-effort behavior; no player/API rewriting or DRM manipulation
